description: Top-level index for hyperCAD-S (OPEN MIND) CAD operations. hyperCAD-S is a hybrid CAD system designed specifically for CAM workflows, with deep integration to hyperMILL CAM. Coverage spans: 2D Sketcher (extensive — more variants per primitive than Fusion), 3D Solid Modeler (with direct-edit), Surface Modeler (Coons / network / refit — hyperCAD's strength), Healing/Repair (hyperCAD's killer feature for imported geometry), Mesh Modeler (with feature-line extraction for hyperMILL), Assembly, Drawing (2D-from-3D output), and Datum/Reference geometry. Consumed by HyperCADCADFunctionIndexEngine for lookup, parameter discovery, and AI orchestration of CAD generation.

modules.description: 2D sketching with hyperCAD-S extensive variant set: Line (8 creation modes including ortho / parallel / perpendicular / tangent / polar / offset), Rectangle (4 methods), Circle (5 methods including tangent-2-circles and tangent-3-elements), Arc (4 methods), Ellipse (3-axis), Polygon (regular + irregular + by-points), Spline (interpolation / control-polygon / tangent), Slot (linear / arc / multi-arc), Point (single / by-intersection / by-parameter / by-projection), Editing (Trim / Extend / Break / Mirror / Offset / Scale / Rotate / Translate / Stretch / Sketch-Fillet / Sketch-Chamfer / Match), Constraints (15 types incl. Concentric / Collinear / Symmetric / Lock-distance), Dimensions (Linear / Angular / Diameter / Radius / Distance-between / Driven / Driving / Reference), Reference geometry (Project edge / Project face / Intersect surface / Project silhouette), and Query (Length / Area / Distance / Angle / Coordinates).

future_modules.scope: Solid creation primitives (box/cylinder/cone/sphere/torus/pipe/block), sweep features (extrude/revolve/sweep/loft/pipe-along-curve/helix), modify (fillet/chamfer/round/variable-round/shell/draft/hollow/thicken), Boolean (union/subtract/intersect/split-by-plane/split-by-surface/split-by-curve), pattern (linear/circular/path/sketch/mirror/variable), direct-edit (move-face/offset-face/push-pull/replace-face/delete-face/resize/edit), holes (simple/cbore/csink/tap/thread/custom), threading (internal/external/cosmetic/helical)

Surface creation (Patch / Boundary / Coons / Network / Sweep / Loft / Revolve / Extrude / Plane / Ruled / Tabulated / Helical), modify (Trim / Extend / Untrim / Offset / Stitch / Unstitch / Reverse / Match / Blend / Surface-Fillet / Surface-Chamfer / Replace / Refit), conversion (Surface-to-Solid / Solid-to-Surface / Mesh-to-Surface)
